operation.description: python executes a fresh bounded calculation; submit grades answer once and ends. No intermediate correctness feedback.
operation.title: Operation

code.description: Python code for python operation, print numeric results. Fresh process every call. math/statistics imports, loops, comprehensions, functions and common numeric/list/dict builtins available. No filesystem/network, introspection, eval/exec, numpy, scipy, json, f-strings, string formatting, classes or private attributes. Limit 3 CPU seconds and 4000 output characters. Use print(dict(...)) to inspect results; variables do not persist.
code.title: Code

answer.description: For submit: JSON object text with exactly the required numeric keys and finite numeric values. No strings, booleans, lists or extra keys. Do not round aggressively. Empty answer submits no solution. All required correct => reward 1; otherwise at most 0.15 proportional numeric credit.
